stem: Which broader chapter contains the most directly relevant sections for congenital malformations and syndrome recognition?
explanation: Genetics is the correct answer because the chapter includes congenital malformations and common genetic syndromes, which are the most directly relevant sections for dysmorphology and syndrome recognition.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Genetics chapter contents

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the Genetics chapter includes congenital malformations and common genetic syndromes.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Rheumatology focuses on inflammatory and autoimmune conditions, not dysmorphology.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because Paediatric Surgery covers surgical conditions rather than the main genetics chapter content for syndrome recognition.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because red cell disorders are haematology topics and not the relevant chapter for congenital malformations.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because musculoskeletal symptoms are not the primary chapter for congenital malformations and syndrome recognition.
